title.en: An Act Declaring Basista, Province of Pangasinan, Created by Executive Order Numbered Four Hundred Forty-Six Dated September Five, Nineteen Hundred Sixty-One, as a Duly Constituted Municipality
title.orig: An Act Declaring Basista, Province of Pangasinan, Created by Executive Order Numbered Four Hundred Forty-Six Dated September Five, Nineteen Hundred Sixty-One, as a Duly Constituted Municipality

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

text.en:
The town of Basista, Province of Pangasinan, created by Executive Order Numbered Four hundred forty-six dated September five, nineteen hundred sixty-one, is hereby declared a duly constituted municipality as of the date it was created by said executive order.
All elective officials of said town shall continue to hold office until their successors are elected and shall have qualified.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: May 8, 1967.
